newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR unchanged as banks sidelined.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR unchanged as banks sidelined.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) remained firm on Wednesday, unchanged from the previous day's rates as traders sought a clearer direction in domestic interest rates to emerge.
"Everybody wants the next bank to move first. Nobody's making the first move," one trader said.
He said traders were still tentative despite the marginal decline in Treasury bill rates on Monday, because regional exotics were still under attack.
Traders were still quoting higher swap rates to position ahead of a possible rate hike by the central bank to defend the peso.
